question: How many films are rated PG-13?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG-13'

question: How many customers are inactive?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 0

question: What is the average film length in minutes, rounded to two decimal places?
SQL: SELECT ROUND(AVG(length), 2) FROM film

question: List the titles of films longer than 180 minutes.
SQL: SELECT title FROM film WHERE length > 180

question: How many actors have the last name Davis?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actor WHERE last_name = 'DAVIS'

question: What is the email address of the customer Mary Smith?
SQL: SELECT email FROM customer WHERE first_name = 'MARY' AND last_name = 'SMITH'

question: How many payments were greater than $10?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payment WHERE amount > 10

question: How many cities in Canada are in the database?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM city ci JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'Canada'

question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?
evidence: a rental that has not been returned has no return_date
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL

question: What was the total amount of payments made in March 2022?
SQL: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2022-03-01' AND payment_date < '2022-04-01'

question: How many films include Deleted Scenes as a special feature?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE 'Deleted Scenes' = ANY(special_features)

question: List the names of all film categories.
SQL: SELECT name FROM category

question: Which country has the most customers?
SQL: SELECT co.country FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id GROUP BY co.country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many films are in the Horror category?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_category fc JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: List the titles of films that Penelope Guiness acted in.
SQL: SELECT f.title FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

question: What is the total payment amount processed by each staff member? Give their first name, last name and the total.
SQL: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN staff s ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name

question: Which customer has rented the most films? Give their first and last name.
SQL: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct films does store 2 have in its inventory?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) FROM inventory WHERE store_id = 2

question: What is the average rental rate for each film rating, rounded to two decimal places? Give the rating and the average.
SQL: SELECT rating, ROUND(AVG(rental_rate), 2) FROM film GROUP BY rating

question: Which film category has the longest average film length?
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY AVG(f.length) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the titles of films that no store has a copy of.
SQL: SELECT f.title FROM film f WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory i WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id)

question: How many customers live in London?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer cu JOIN address a ON cu.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE ci.city = 'London'

question: What is the total payment revenue from films in the Sports category?
SQL: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Sports'

question: Which actor has appeared in the most films? Give their first and last name.
SQL: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM film_actor fa JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many rentals of store 1's inventory were made in July 2022?
evidence: a rental belongs to the store that holds the rented inventory item
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.store_id = 1 AND r.rental_date >= '2022-07-01' AND r.rental_date < '2022-08-01'

question: What is the average total amount paid per customer, rounded to two decimal places?
evidence: first total each customer's payments, then average those totals
SQL: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: How many films are rated R and are longer than two hours?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'R' AND length > 120

question: How many Comedy films are longer than the average length of all films?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Comedy' AND f.length > (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film)

question: Which customers have more than one rental that has not been returned? Give their first and last names.
evidence: a rental that has not been returned has no return_date
SQL: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE r.return_date IS NULL GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: How many active customers does each store have? Give the store id and the count.
SQL: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE active = 1 GROUP BY store_id

question: What percentage of films have a rental rate of $0.99, rounded to two decimal places?
SQL: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rental_rate = 0.99) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM film

question: How many distinct customers have rented an Animation film?
SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Animation'

question: What percentage of total payment revenue does each film category account for? Give the category name and the percentage rounded to two decimal places.
SQL: SELECT c.name, ROUND(100 * SUM(p.amount) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payment), 2) FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name

question: How many customers have spent more in total than the average customer?
evidence: a customer's spend is the sum of their payments
SQL: WITH t AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM t)

question: Who are the top three actors by total payment revenue from rentals of films they appear in? Give their first and last names.
SQL: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 3

question: For each store, which film category has the most rentals? Give the store id and the category name.
evidence: a rental belongs to the store that holds the rented inventory item
SQL: SELECT store_id, name FROM (SELECT i.store_id, c.name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.store_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rk FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY i.store_id, c.category_id, c.name) t WHERE rk = 1

question: For each month of 2022, what was the total payment revenue and its change from the previous month? Give the month as YYYY-MM, the revenue and the change.
evidence: the first month has no previous month, so its change is null
SQL: SELECT month, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(payment_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2022-01-01' AND payment_date < '2023-01-01' GROUP BY 1) t

question: How many rentals were returned late?
evidence: a rental is late when it was kept longer than the film's rental_duration in days
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL AND r.return_date - r.rental_date > f.rental_duration * INTERVAL '1 day'

question: Among returned rentals, which film category has the longest average time a rental was kept?
evidence: time kept is return_date minus rental_date
SQL: SELECT c.name FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY AVG(r.return_date - r.rental_date) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many actors have appeared in at least one film of every rating?
evidence: the ratings are G, PG, PG-13, R and NC-17
SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT fa.actor_id FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY fa.actor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.rating) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rating) FROM film)) t
